author: Twillion
name: ExternalSkeletalAnimator3D
shortDescription: Play skeletal animations from separate .glb files on any rigged 3D Model, so one animation library can drive many different characters.
description:
Animate a rigged 3D Model with clips that live in OTHER .glb files, instead of baking every animation into every character.

Build one animation library and point every character at it. Clips are matched onto each model's own skeleton by bone name, ignoring rig namespaces such as "mixamorig:" and the per-export numbering Mixamo adds, so characters rigged separately still share animations.

Characters keep their own proportions. A clip authored for a taller character does not stretch a shorter one: bone lengths stay the target's, root motion is rescaled to its height, and only the rotations - the part that is actually the animation - are transferred.

One .glb can hold many clips; pick one by name or index. Split the skeleton into layers to run with the legs while swinging with the arms. Pin objects to bones, with orientation, for weapons and effects. Match animation speed to how fast the character is really moving so the feet stay planted.

Runs on the animation mixer the engine already owns, so it crossfades with - and takes over from - the object's built-in animations at no extra cost.

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: ExternalSkeletalAnimator3D
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Play animation clips from other .glb files on this model’s skeleton. One file can hold many clips, addressed as (file, clip name). Clips adapt to this character’s proportions.

propertyDescriptors.name: DefaultAnimation
propertyDescriptors.label: Default animation file
propertyDescriptors.description: Animation .glb played when the object is created. Leave empty for none.

propertyDescriptors.name: DefaultClip
propertyDescriptors.label: Default clip name
propertyDescriptors.description: Clip inside the default file. Leave empty to use the first clip.

propertyDescriptors.name: RootMotionMode
propertyDescriptors.label: Root motion
propertyDescriptors.description: How the root bone’s translation is handled.

propertyDescriptors.name: AutoCleanBoneNames
propertyDescriptors.label: Auto-clean bone names
propertyDescriptors.description: Ignore rig namespaces such as "mixamorig:" when matching bones.

propertyDescriptors.name: AdaptToProportions
propertyDescriptors.label: Adapt to this model’s proportions
propertyDescriptors.description: Keep this character’s own bone lengths and rescale root motion to its height, instead of taking the proportions of whoever the animation was made for. Turn off only to replay a clip exactly as authored.

eventsFunctions.name: PlayAnimation
eventsFunctions.description: Play clip _PARAM3_ from the animation file _PARAM2_ on _PARAM0_ (loop: _PARAM4_, speed: _PARAM5_, crossfade: _PARAM6_s)

parameters.name: ClipName
parameters.description: Clip name inside that file (leave empty for the first clip)

eventsFunctions.name: PlayAnimationByIndex
eventsFunctions.description: Play clip number _PARAM3_ from the animation file _PARAM2_ on _PARAM0_ (loop: _PARAM4_, speed: _PARAM5_, crossfade: _PARAM6_s)

parameters.name: ClipIndex
parameters.description: Clip index (0 = first clip in the file)
